_note: Test Foamer (ENG-10): rig F01 from data/foamer-rigs.json, with part damage, breaking, handicaps, wounds, going down and popping. Distances in metres, times in seconds. Rig shapes, speed and health come from the rig file (one source).

partDamage._note: Per part kind. hpShare: the part's health as a share of the Foamer's (at least minHp). hit: multiplies dart damage to the part. total: share of that damage that also comes off the Foamer's health. CONTENT-PLAN 3.1 and 3.2.

catastrophic._note: Pop when the damage from popTypes dart types in the last window seconds is at least share of max health. No starter dart type pops (Paul, 2026-11-01): heavier darts and blaster mods add theirs.
